title: Fix the CSV record splitter
task: split_record(line) in src/lib.rs has parsing bugs. Fix it to this contract without changing its signature or UnterminatedQuote. Remove at most one line terminator ("\r\n" or "\n") from the end of line first. Fields are separated by commas and every field is kept, including empty ones: "" gives [""], "a," gives ["a", ""], "," gives ["", ""]. Unquoted fields are kept verbatim, including spaces and any double quote that is not the first character of the field (ab"c is the field ab"c). A double quote that is the first character of a field starts a quoted section: commas, newlines and carriage returns inside it are literal, "" inside it is one double quote, and it ends at the next single double quote. Return Err(UnterminatedQuote) if the record ends inside a quoted section. Add regression tests.
